```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-root-ttree-requests
#| fig-cap: "Requests and read system calls per event on the full dataset. The mapped path serves every event with one aligned request and zero application-level read system calls."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

metrics = ['reads/event', 'syscalls/event']
x = np.arange(len(metrics))
w = 0.25
base = [0.20, 0.20]
coord = [1.00, 1.00]
mapped = [1.00, 0.00]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))
ax.bar(x - w, base, w, label='baseline', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax.bar(x, coord, w, label='coordinate', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='///')
ax.bar(x + w, mapped, w, label='coordinate+map', color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, hatch='...')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel('count per event', fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5)
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
